https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasmtime/blob/11eac9de8693e1a69f86815d1a58918edd5c1785/cranelift/README.md?plain=1#L127-L128

point to the testing docs.

cfallin commented on issue #14433:

Thanks @maekawatoshiki -- happy to take a PR to update the readme to point to current tests (cargo test -p cranelift-tools, cargo test -p cranelift-codegen). Also we should probably note that since Cranelift lives within the Wasmtime repo now (since 2020), it is covered by Wasmtime's CI checks as well, including for code formatting and lints.
